title: Advances in oxide thermoelectric materials: strategies, applications and beyond
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01078K, Review Article
Qing Wang, Zhifang Zhou, Chang Liu, Yunpeng Zheng, Zongmo Shi, Bin Wei, Wenyu Zhang, Ce-Wen Nan, Yuan-Hua Lin
This review outlines recent advancements in oxide thermoelectrics, spanning from material synthesis to optimization strategies, and emerging applications alongside future perspectives.
